/bin/bash -lc "python -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from subprocess import run, check_output
import json
root = Path.cwd()
archive = root / 'archive'
deployment = json.loads((archive/'deployment.json').read_text())
field = json.loads((archive/'field-observation.json').read_text())
with TemporaryDirectory(dir=root, prefix='.retro-') as work:
    scratch = Path(work)
    repo = scratch / 'repo'
    run(['git','clone','--quiet','--no-checkout',str(archive/'desk.bundle'),str(repo)], check=True)
    for revision in ['recorded-fix"'^'"', 'recorded-fix', deployment['releasedCommit']]:
        resolved = check_output(['git','-C',str(repo),'rev-parse',revision], text=True).strip()
        app = scratch / 'desk.mjs'
        app.write_bytes(check_output(['git','-C',str(repo),'show',f'{resolved}:desk.mjs']))
        sample = scratch / 'sample.json'
        sample.write_bytes((archive/'sample.json').read_bytes())
        def invoke(*args):
            result = run(['node',str(app),str(sample),*args], cwd=scratch, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
            return result.stdout
        before = invoke('list')
        mark = invoke('mark','D7')
        saved = json.loads(sample.read_text())
        after = invoke('list')
        print(resolved[:7], 'before=',before.strip(), 'mark=',mark.strip(), 'saved=',saved, 'after=',after.strip())
        if resolved == deployment['releasedCommit']:
            assert resolved == field['packagedRevision']
            assert saved == field['afterWriter']
            assert [mark,after] == [entry['stdout'] for entry in field['commandsInSeparateProcesses']]
PY"
